findings.claim: OC133-NOVELTY-001: Prior-art comparison is an illustrative bounded positioning note; uniqueness, priority, and absence are not promoted until a systematic search exists.
findings.failure_mode: The snapshots are only local bibliographic/search-protocol capsules and explicitly not full source captures. That is acceptable for non-promotion, but it leaves the accepted_overlap and bounded_positioning_note fields insufficiently auditable as source-backed bibliographic positioning.
findings.required_repair: Either add source excerpts/pages/section anchors with access metadata for each snapshot, or downgrade the register/schema wording from source-backed positioning to bibliography-only protocol notes.

findings.claim: Bounded positioning note that OC combines a typed theorem ledger, executable finite witnesses, numeric replay QA, falsifier registry, and owner-gated no-send publication controls.
findings.failure_mode: Rows 11-14 admit overlap with assurance cases, GSN, traceability matrices, and RO-Crate, but the remaining bundle language still risks prior-art relabeling of established assurance/reproducibility/release-gate practices. No uniqueness is promoted, so this is not high severity, but the delta is not bibliographically separated.
findings.required_repair: Add explicit comparator rows for software release governance, certification evidence packages, CI/CD quality gates, repository embargo/no-send workflows, and publication/repository deposit controls; then state the OC bundle as local integration only unless a systematic search supports a narrower delta.

findings.claim: T133-BOUNDARY: Metric thresholds are a specialization of typed classifier boundaries.
findings.failure_mode: The claim text reads as an absolute mathematical/general classifier statement even though the row is only a no-send formal release-consistency check. The comparator register has no metric topology, decision-boundary, or classifier-threshold prior-art row to prevent relabeling.
findings.required_repair: Rewrite the claim as bounded to declared v12 classifier semantics and add a comparator row covering metric/topological thresholds, statistical or ML decision boundaries, and classifier theory.
